item.title: Supabase Realtime Rust (Websockets)
item.description: See on Github What it is A component for the Supabase community-built Rust client that enables the realtime (websocket) features This crate allows sending websocket messages in real-time between different clients. This can enable real-time updates of data, chatrooms, even establishing WebRTC connections between users.
